answer: Deal each identity a lottery of task families from the block hash, so no agent can farm one task type: 100 challenges from 12 families, 95 percent in 200 ms, a 150 POA bond, 5 witnesses. One honest agent runs 1 endpoint and finishes its dealt mix; 10 fakes must hold 10 pipes and witness slots, scaling cost linearly. Peers audit public logs, slash bonds of identities missing their dealt families, and freeze repeat offenders. Terrace, echo, ivory: honest work, verified history, open proof make fakery uneconomical.
